mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing mainly clear skies around the Verona Area High School with a temperature of 77 degrees, though it feels like 81.

In city news, construction is moving into phase two near the Aldi development starting the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns along Highway M. Additionally, the Verona Police Department has arrested a Madison woman following a report from the school district regarding an incident from 2019.

There is plenty to do in our city, with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga, and looking ahead, we have trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
The Verona Police Department has reported that they initiated an investigation and made an arrest following a report of an incident that occurred on Sunday, August 30, 2026.
For a sweet treat, Culver's is serving up Chocolate Covered Strawberry today. They are open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
